description: Human (hot-seat) deployment of attached units through the real DeploymentController UI at 11e (review L1-1..L1-5, L6-3). Both seats human, deployment alternating naturally: Player 1 sets up a Custodian Guard squad (plain DEPLOY_UNIT) between each Ork unit. (a) Lootas Alpha + Big Mek Beta: the attached unit is picked from the unit list (one row), the Select Model Type picker is clicked, 10 Lootas + the Big Mek are placed, the real Confirm button is clicked -> COMPOSITE_DEPLOY accepted, both DEPLOYED, exactly one board token per model, and the game log reads 'Deployed Lootas Alpha + Big Mek Beta (11 models)' (L1-5). (c1)+(b) Lootas Beta + Big Mek Gamma: the Big Mek is first dropped 7in away -> Confirm is REFUSED by the UI coherency gate with an error toast while the session stays open (nothing finalized or stranded); the leader is picked back up with a real Shift+click and dropped where it is the 10th Loota's only 2in neighbour -> Confirm ACCEPTED (L1-3: the phase used to also demand the Lootas be coherent on their own, refused, and stranded the unit - ghost tokens, status DEPLOYING, gone from the list). (c2) Warbikers Alpha (MOUNTED): a placed bike is lifted with Shift+click over the wall of corner-ruin-left-19 (5in dense) -> the lifted ghost reports the spot invalid and the drop is refused with a toast, the bike stays put (L1-1: the reposition validator had no wall / solid-piece check, so the drop was accepted and the phase refused the unit at Confirm) -> Confirm accepted. Final invariant: no unit is left DEPLOYING outside a session and every deployed unit has every model on the board. Model drops use DeploymentController.try_place_at (the function every board click calls); unit selection, the picker, Confirm, and the Shift+click lift / drop are real input.

steps.script:
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var pts = []
pts.append(Vector2(300.0, 200.0))
pts.append(Vector2(370.0, 200.0))
pts.append(Vector2(440.0, 200.0))
pts.append(Vector2(510.0, 200.0))
pts.append(Vector2(580.0, 200.0))
var bad = []
for i in range(pts.size()):
	var slot = dc.model_idx
	if slot != i:
		bad.append("slot%d->%d" % [i, slot])
		break
	dc.try_place_at(pts[i])
	if dc.temp_positions[slot] == null:
		bad.append("refused%d" % i)
return "placed %d/%d coherent=%s confirm=%s bad=%s" % [dc.get_placed_count(), dc.get_total_model_count(), str(dc._is_unit_coherent()), str(tree.current_scene.confirm_button.visible), str(bad)]
